Here’s a high‑level advanced Keras project: implementing SimCLR-style self‑supervised contrastive learning on the STL-10 dataset, enabling your model to learn powerful embeddings without labels and then fine‑tune for classification. This is significantly more advanced than typical supervised models and introduces complex augmentation pipelines, projection heads, contrastive loss (NT-Xent), and semi‑supervised tuning.

Project Title

ai-ml-ds-ZeP7QdXkVyA
Filename: simclr_ssl_stl10.py

Short Description

Self‑supervised training using SimCLR on STL‑10: learn representations via contrastive loss on augmented image pairs then fine‑tune a linear classifier using a small labeled subset.

simclr_ssl_stl10.py (Python Code)

import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds
import numpy as np

# Hyperparameters
batch_size: int = 256
img_size: int = 96
proj_dim: int = 128
temperature: float = 0.5
epochs_pretrain: int = 100
epochs_finetune: int = 50
learning_rate: float = 0.001

# Data pipeline
def augment(x: tf.Tensor, label=None):
    x = tf.image.random_flip_left_right(x)
    x = tf.image.random_crop(x, size=[img_size, img_size, 3])
    x = tf.image.random_brightness(x, 0.5)
    return x

def simclr_augment(x: tf.Tensor, label=None):
    xi = augment(x)
    xj = augment(x)
    return (xi, xj), label

ds_unlabeled = tfds.load('stl10', split='unlabelled', as_supervised=True)
ds_unlabeled = ds_unlabeled.map(simclr_augment).shuffle(10000).batch(batch_size).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

ds_labeled = tfds.load('stl10', split='train', as_supervised=True)
ds_labeled = ds_labeled.map(lambda x, y: (tf.image.resize(x, [img_size,img_size]), y))
ds_labeled = ds_labeled.shuffle(10000).batch(batch_size).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

ds_test = tfds.load('stl10', split='test', as_supervised=True)
ds_test = ds_test.map(lambda x, y: (tf.image.resize(x, [img_size,img_size]), y))
ds_test = ds_test.batch(batch_size).prefetch(tf.data.AUTOTUNE)

# Encoder + projection
base_encoder = keras.applications.ResNet50(weights=None, include_top=False, input_shape=(img_size,img_size,3), pooling='avg')
inputs = layers.Input((img_size, img_size, 3))
h = base_encoder(inputs)
z = layers.Dense(512, activation='relu')(h)
z = layers.Dense(proj_dim)(z)
encoder = keras.Model(inputs, z, name='encoder')

# Contrastive loss
def nt_xent_loss(y_pred):
    zi, zj = tf.split(y_pred, num_or_size_splits=2, axis=0)
    zi = tf.math.l2_normalize(zi, axis=1)
    zj = tf.math.l2_normalize(zj, axis=1)
    logits = tf.matmul(zi, zj, transpose_b=True) / temperature
    labels = tf.range(batch_size)
    loss_i = keras.losses.sparse_categorical_crossentropy(labels, logits, from_logits=True)
    loss_j = keras.losses.sparse_categorical_crossentropy(labels, tf.transpose(logits), from_logits=True)
    return tf.reduce_mean(loss_i + loss_j) / 2

# Pre‑training
inputs_pairs = layers.Input((img_size,img_size,3))
x1, x2 = inputs_pairs, inputs_pairs
z1 = encoder(x1)
z2 = encoder(x2)
merge = layers.Concatenate(axis=0)([z1, z2])
pretrain_model = keras.Model(inputs_pairs, merge)
pretrain_model.compile(optimizer=keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate), loss=nt_xent_loss)
pretrain_model.fit(ds_unlabeled, epochs=epochs_pretrain)

# Linear finetuning
feature_extractor = keras.Model(base_encoder.input, base_encoder.output, name='feat_ext')
feature_extractor.trainable = False

finetune_inputs = layers.Input((img_size,img_size,3))
x = feature_extractor(finetune_inputs)
x = layers.Dense(256, activation='relu')(x)
out = layers.Dense(10)(x)
finetune_model = keras.Model(finetune_inputs, out)
finetune_model.compile(optimizer=keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate), loss=keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True), metrics=['accuracy'])
finetune_model.fit(ds_labeled, validation_data=ds_test, epochs=epochs_finetune)

Example Use Cases

  • Zero-shot representation: feed new images through encoder, extract embeddings for retrieval or clustering.
  • Fine-tune with small labels: obtain >80% accuracy using only ~5% labeled data.
  • Downstream tasks: use embeddings for transfer learning on CIFAR-10 or image retrieval.

Key Learnings

  • Data augmentation pipelines
  • Representation learning + fine-tuning
  • Hyperparameter impact: temperature, batch size
